attchmntText: Kellton Tech Solutions Limited has informed the Exchange about Investor Presentation
voiceSummary: Kellton Tech Solutions Limited filed an earning presentation regarding un-audited financial results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026. The company reported total revenue of Rs 3,206 million, representing a 6.5 percent year-on-year increase. EBITDA stood at Rs 387 million with a margin of 12.1 percent. Profit after tax was Rs 230 million, yielding a PAT margin of 7.2 percent and earnings per share of Rs 0.43. The filing also highlighted a new joint venture with Action Energy Company K.S.C.P. for the GCC oil and gas market. Additionally, the company received industry recognition, including first prize at the SEBI Securities Market TechSprint 2026 for its NIYAMA solution. Several new engagements were announced, including projects for a leading automotive finance company and a US healthcare provider.

attchmntText: Kellton Tech Solutions Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated November 14, 2026, titled "Press Release".
voiceSummary: Kellton Tech Solutions Ltd filed its press release on unaudited financial results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026, with the document dated November 14, 2026. Total revenue for the quarter was 3,206 million rupees, up 1.4 percent quarter on quarter. EBITDA was 387 million rupees with a margin of 12.1 percent. Net profit stood at 230.00 million rupees, and earnings per share were 0.43 rupees. The company announced a joint venture with Action Energy Company K.S.C.P. for the GCC market. It also secured six new projects including engagements with an automotive finance company, a US healthcare firm, and a Saudi Arabian airline. Kellton received awards for its NIYAMA and SBI AURA solutions at the SEBI Securities Market TechSprint 2026 and SEBI Hackathon 2026.

attchmntText: Kellton Tech Solutions Limited has informed the Exchange about General Updates
voiceSummary: Kellton Tech Solutions Limited board approved unaudited financial results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026. The statutory auditors issued a limited review report on November 14, 2026. The board also approved the constitution of a Banking and Finance Committee. Mr. Niranjan Chintam serves as chairperson. Mr. Krishna Chintam and Mr. Karanjit Singh are members. The committee handles banking, borrowings, and overseas investments. The trading window for designated persons remains closed from October 1, 2026.

attchmntText: Kellton Tech Solutions Limited has informed the Exchange about Schedule of meet
voiceSummary: Kellton Tech Solutions Limited has announced an earnings conference call to discuss the financial performance for the second quarter of the fiscal year 2026-27. The call is scheduled for Monday, November 16, 2026, at 5:00 PM IST. Management representatives including Mr. Niranjan Chintam, Mr. Karanjit Singh, and Mr. Srinivas Potluri will participate. The event can be joined via the link https://tinyurl.com/5ncrbhs6 or through provided dial-in numbers for India, the USA, the UK, Singapore, Hong Kong, and France. The notice was issued by Company Secretary Muskan Manucha on November 11, 2026.
